column2: Company Summary

1Huddle is a mobile game platform that helps companies onboard and upskill their employees quickly and easily. They have over 70 paying clients, 20,000 users, and have been featured on major news outlets. They raised $7.9 million in a Series A funding round in 2015.
7Bridges, a tech company, raised $3.4M in 2020. Their website is https://www.the7bridges.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/j82YnRM5DywNZ5.

43 Layers is an e-commerce marketplace that allows customers to design and create custom gifts, decor, and accessories. Founded in 2014, the company offers high-quality and affordable products for weddings, dinner parties, and special occasions. 43 Layers is currently in the seed stage and has a website and pitch deck available.

100Plus is a remote patient monitoring platform that empowers doctors to manage chronic patients remotely and proactively engage them to avoid expensive, episodic care and drive a higher quality of life. The company received $39.8 million in seed funding in 2011 and offers medical devices at no cost to patients or practices.

Food and beverage company 1906 raised $18M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://1906newhighs.com/ and its pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/K4d0Pk4zmxP6OZ.

AbbeyPost is an e-commerce company that offers custom-made apparel for plus-size women in the USA, with the goal of providing affordable, well-made clothing that fits. They have a 70% gross profit margin and a 50% repeat purchase rate within 30 days. In 2012, they received $775,000 in seed funding.

Aceup is an EdTech company that raised $1.7M in seed funding in 2019. Their website is https://aceup.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/yoBBOF3aq9m4v1.

Acin is a fintech company that aims to make banks safer and transform the financial industry's approach to non-financial risk through data. It raised $12 million in a Series A funding round in 2018 and offers its services through its website.

Acquco is an E-commerce platform that acquires and grows Amazon Marketplace businesses. Co-founded by former Amazon workers Raunak Nirmal and Wiley Zhang in 2020, the New York-based company raised $160 million in a Series A funding round and has a pitch deck available on Slideshare.

ActivityHero is an EdTech platform connecting parents with after-school activity providers and summer camps. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Palo Alto, California, it raised $2.2 million in seed funding.

Ada Health is a global health company that connects medical knowledge with intelligent technology to help people manage their health and medical professionals deliver effective care. They collaborate with leading health systems and global non-profit organizations. Ada Health is currently in Series-B stage.

Adventure Bucket List is an enterprise SaaS platform for tourism destinations that brings activities and tours online, monetizes traditional tourism listing websites, and empowers local businesses. The company raised $200,000 in seed funding in 2014 and provides an OpenTable-like service for experiences.

Aeris is a provider of indoor air quality treatment systems, offering air purifiers that constantly track air quality and occupancy to ensure the best air quality with low energy consumption. They received $9.6 million in a Series-B funding round in 2014 and continue to push boundaries in filter technology, air quality sensors, and minimalist design.

Aftersale is a Brazilian company that improves customer service quality by simplifying solutions to complex problems. It connects branded consumers through interfaces in an omnichannel concept, increasing logistics and fulfillment efficiency and eliminating customer experience gaps in the process of exchanging and returning purchases. Aftersale serves major clients in the Fashion and Accessories, Cosmetics and Beauty, Professional Products, and Home and Decoration segments. In 2018, the company received $645,200 in seed funding.

AgFunder is an investment firm that manages a portfolio of over 50 companies across four funds. It focuses on impactful companies that can positively transform the world's food system and has a global ecosystem of over 90,000 subscribers through its media platform AFN. Founded in 2013, AgFunder is in the later stage and has offices in Silicon Valley and Singapore.

Agora is a shopping platform that uses short-form video content. It has over 50,000 products on its marketplace and allows users to share recommendations through livestreams and video reviews. It raised $8.2 million in 2019 and is in the Other stage. Website: https://www.agoraworld.co/

Aircall, a tech company, raised $65M in 2020 in a later stage funding round. The company's website is https://aircall.io/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/sLkbP62gHiiBwM.

Alan Healthcare is a healthcare company that raised $28M in a Series-A funding round in 2018. The company's website is https://alan.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/DQ8SQngeoCt1Af.

Alba is an on-demand childcare service that matches families with trained caregivers from their social networks and neighborhoods. The service is supervised and standardized with 24/7 support, liability insurance, and real-time updates for parents. Founded in 2016, Alba provides a high-quality experience for parents, children, and caregivers.

Albert is a fintech company founded in 2015 that aims to democratize money management by providing affordable financial advice and personalized financial plans. The company's platform includes automated investing, budgeting, and savings features, as well as Albert Instant, which offers customers an advance against their paychecks. Albert has raised $175.6 million in funding and is backed by investors including General Atlantic, 500 Startups, and CapitalG.

AlfredCamera is an IoT security brand that provides affordable and easy-to-use home security products, trusted by 40 million families worldwide. The company aims to make smart home technology accessible to everyone and is continuously developing the latest IoT technologies. AlfredCamera was founded in 2015 and is currently in the seed stage.

Algolia is a search-as-a-service platform that enables companies to deliver fast and relevant digital experiences across web, mobile, and voice. It helps developers and business teams build and optimize search and discovery experiences that increase online engagement, conversion rates, and revenue. Algolia is in the tech industry and is at a later stage.

Alluva is a platform that aims to boost institutional investment in the cryptocurrency space by building the world's largest analyst marketplace. It helps potential investors explore the best of blockchain technology and identify cryptocurrencies to invest in, while steering clear of scams. Alluva raised $10.2 million in seed funding in 2018 and is focused on building mass adoption of digital assets and blockchain tech.

In 2014, Almabase, an EdTech company, received $100,000 in funding to empower colleges to build a thriving alumni community. Their website provides more information, and their pitch deck is available on SlideShare.

Almanac, a tech company, raised $9M in seed funding in 2020. Their website is https://almanac.io/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/1X70se8j8HMet.

Althea is a Korean e-commerce platform that offers beauty products, trends, and lifestyle to Southeast Asian consumers. The company raised $10.7 million in 2015 and is in the later stage of development.

Alto is a San Francisco-based start-up that helps users coordinate with physicians and insurance companies to receive medication. Since its founding in 2015, Alto has raised over $350 million in investment, including $250 million in series D funding in 2020.

Alto Pharmacy is a digital pharmacy founded in 2015 that combines expert pharmacist care with technology to deliver a more convenient and affordable experience for those who need medication. They have fulfilled over three million prescriptions, expanded to twelve markets, and have an industry-leading NPS score of 86. They raised $560 million in 2015 and are in the later stage.

Altruist is a financial advice company that aims to make advice more affordable and accessible through software that makes advisors more efficient. Founded in 2018, the company raised $58.5 million in a Series-B funding round and is headquartered in Venice Beach, California.

Alumnify is a San Francisco-based solution launched in 2013 that helps graduates build alumni connections, establish new university communities, and create job opportunities. It raised $1.3 million in seed funding in 2013 and operates in the "Other" industry. Its website is http://www.alumnify.co/ and its pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/ilUmTWoPfEGJw5.

Alyce, a tech company, raised $11M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.alyce.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/u48t7wXa4DOPkd.

Amify is an e-commerce full-service Amazon agency that helps vendors become successful by providing support in strategic decisions, operations, management, and advertising. They received $5.8M in series A funding in March 2019 to increase their Amazon E-commerce potential. They are currently in the seed stage.

Amixr is an incident management platform with Slack integration that optimizes channels, recipients, and content to increase the speed of solving IT problems. It has been shown to increase incident reaction time up to 3 times and raised $500,000 in 2018 for its later stage development.

AMPAworks is a team of doctors, nurses, and engineers who have built an IoT system leveraging computer vision deep learning to monitor and re-order inventory in hospitals. They provide real-time data that saves the average hospital $10 million annually by automating manual inventory enumeration tasks. They raised $1.4 million in seed funding in 2019 and have a pitch deck available at http://www.ampaworks.com/.

Angelcam is a cloud-based security solution that enables users to remotely access and manage their security cameras, view live streams and recordings, and share them with trusted contacts. They are working on a mobile app to eliminate false alarms and enable trusted contacts to verify alarms and take action. Their vision is to create a network of trusted contacts to better protect communities. They received $299,600 in funding in 2011.

Anima, a platform that turns designs into code, raised $12.6M in a Series A funding round in 2017. The company's website is http://www.animaapp.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/gMumPkqqEMFzYt.

Anrok is a sales tax solution for SaaS businesses that unifies sales tax monitoring, calculation, and remittance. The company raised $24.3 million in a Series A funding round in 2020 and offers its services through its website.

Apheris AI, founded by Robin Rohm and Michael Hoh, aims to empower companies to run analytics on decentralized datasets. They encountered barriers that limit progress within data-driven industries, and strive to connect the world's data to extract better insights. They raised $11.7 million in seed funding in 2019.

AppBind is a cloud software reseller channel that enables agencies and consultants to procure cloud subscriptions for clients and manage expenses automatically. It creates credit cards that automatically expenses clients when users buy SaaS, ads, and digital assets on their behalf. Founded in 2018, AppBind is currently in the seed stage.

AppNexus is a cloud-based software platform that allows marketers to connect and engage with consumers on websites and apps. The company has raised an unknown amount of money in a seed round and is funded by 22 investors, but has not disclosed the amount of funds raised. The industry is media and the pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/A8Cfodobt4fOkO.

Apptite is a Brazilian app that delivers meals cooked by independent chefs to your door, offering a variety of dishes from chicken soup to truffle lasagna. The company raised $3.1 million in a pre-seed funding round in 2016.

Apptopia is a mobile app analytics company that provides user engagement statistics through its Insights platform. The company was founded in 2012 and raised $35.5 million in a Series C funding round in 2011, with a total of $5 million in annual run rate by May 2014.

Apricity, a healthcare company, raised $7M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.apricity.life/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/uSFm0taf5qr01Z.

Apteo is a tech company that raised $11M in seed funding in 2019. Their website is https://www.apteo.co/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/7llu5rCdOJly8n.

Arangodb, a tech company, raised $10M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.arangodb.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/FCGa0m5rj59Tya.

Arcus, a FinTech company, raised $13M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.arcusfi.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/8aBO934vpPFU0Y.

Arive is an e-commerce platform that offers a wide range of essential products and delivers them quickly through inner-city logistics. The platform provides personal care, beauty, pantry, fitness, and household products, enabling customers to shop for branded products. Arive is currently in the Series-A stage and was founded in an unknown year.

Arrcus, a tech company, raised $30M in a Series-B funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.arrcus.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/eynsSigrSnEckz.

ArtCorgi is a marketplace for commissioned art that simplifies the process by offering up-front prices, streamlined communication, and a straightforward creation process. The company raised $200,000 in seed funding in 2013 and operates in the "Other" industry.

Ascend is a tech company that raised $19M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.ascend.io/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/mYiO91wrP16xn3.

http://ascend.io/ is a data and analytics engineering automation platform that unifies data ingestion, transformation, delivery, orchestration, and observability into a single platform. The company has raised $50 million in a Series-B funding round and is backed by notable venture capital firms and advisors. http://ascend.io/ was named a 2021 Gartner Cool Vendor and aims to help data teams deliver 10x faster.

AstroPrint offers cloud-based software products for the Additive Manufacturing industry, including Enterprise Fleet Management for multi-user 3D printer environments. Their suite of components includes online build plate, toolpath viewers, slicing engines, remote monitoring/management, print history, advanced analytics, and more. They received $2.2M in seed funding in 2013 and have managed 3.5M 3D prints and 8M hours of cloud 3D printing.

Atexto is a software that provides labeled speech data for companies to personalize machine learning models for voice understanding, and allows individuals to record and store their voiceprint, label it, and earn money. The company raised $1.1 million in seed funding in 2018 and operates in the Other industry.

AtoB is a San Francisco-based technology company that builds payments infrastructure for the transportation industry. Founded in 2019 by Harshita Arora, Vignan Velivela, and Tushar Misra, AtoB raised $257 million in funding and has a pitch deck available on SlideShare.

Atomwise, a healthcare company, raised $123M in a Series-B funding round in 2020. The company's website is https://www.atomwise.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/ODhd7fHOcMjMW.

Auctio is a SaaS marketing platform that generates high-quality leads for enterprise sales and marketing teams through incentive-based referral and cross-selling programs. The platform engages front-line employees and outside influencers to identify business opportunities and submit qualified leads, while providing Sales & Marketing Managers with analytics tools to optimize ROI. Auctio is a long-term marketing initiative and a new marketing channel for Sales and Marketing teams.

Audiomob, an Other industry company, raised $16 million in a Series-A funding round in 2020. The company's website is https://www.audiomob.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/Jl2jJqQQJv6c4l.

Audoo is a London-based technology company that developed the Audio Meter, a device that tracks music played in public performance locations. The company raised $14 million in 2018 and is in the later stage. Their website is https://www.audoo.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/cDAbBjQLhAQ2ab.

Aumet is a platform that connects medical manufacturers and distributors, allowing them to share hospital inquiries, market news, and products. The platform also helps suppliers list their products and connect with distributors, while distributors can search for new products and list their interests. Aumet received $945,000 in funding in 2016 and is in an unspecified stage of development.

Avision is a company that manages airspace and provides a fleet operations management system for drones. They focus on public safety and emergency services support, and are partnered with the FAA and NASA to disrupt cargo delivery and urban air mobility. They received $1,000,000 in funding in 2015.

Avocode is a software that allows designers to export and share designs from Photoshop and Sketch, including colors, fonts, and dimensions. It acts as a bridge between designers and developers. It received $1.5 million in funding in 2014 and has a website and pitch deck available online.

Awake Security, a tech company, raised $36M in 2020 in a later stage funding round. Their website is https://awakesecurity.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/zzmKRN6QqasKsH.

B Great is a cannabis company that raised $2.5M in seed funding in 2020. The company's website is https://www.bgreat.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/vgNtJrzzzROYvN.

BabySparks is an EdTech company that provides tools and programs to help parents engage their babies and toddlers in early development. The company raised $3.8 million in a Series-A funding round in 2013 and is headquartered in Plantation, Florida.

Baby2Body is a coaching program for women focused on optimizing fitness, nutrition, and emotional well-being during fertility, pregnancy, and three years postpartum. They provide nutrition guides and have been active since 1994.
Finally, a fintech company based in Miami, Florida, received $99.1 million in funding in 2018. The company's mission is to automate accounting and finance for small and medium-sized businesses.

Backstartup is a Latin American startup that aims to revolutionize small businesses' relationship with accounting and finances by replacing accountants with their SwaS platform. They use accounting automation bots and bank integrations to eliminate manual tasks and human errors, and provide customers with a virtual administrative support team for a comprehensive service experience. Backstartup received $2.1 million in seed funding in 2014.

Baker Technologies, a company in the "Other" industry, raised $12.5 million in a Series-A funding round in 2014. They build smart products to improve the shopping experience and help businesses grow. Their website is http://www.trybaker.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/fIE0bkHJqWDnvB.
Barn & Willow is an e-commerce brand that offers custom-made window coverings. The company raised $1.5 million in 2015 and operates in the later stage of development.

In 2017, battleface raised $1.14 billion in a Series-A funding round for their travel insurance products and services, which can be accessed from any device. The company aims to provide a better insurance experience for customers and partners.

Beatdapp is a tracking system that authenticates, verifies, and validates real-time media streams, reducing tracking discrepancies between Digital Service Providers and rights holders. The service has raised $2.4M in seed funding and aims to increase royalty revenue for rights holders while limiting legal exposure to royalty lawsuits for DSPs.

BeautyDate is a beauty application that allows users to schedule appointments with various beauty professionals. Founded in 2014 in Brazil, the company received $125,000 in funding in 2011 and is currently in the later stage of development.

Beckley Psytech is a psychedelic medicine company developing a drug pipeline to address unmet clinical needs. They raised $114.2 million in a Series-B funding round in 2019 and have a pitch deck available on SlideShare.

Beeketing is a popular marketing platform for e-commerce with over 400,000 merchants. The company received $225,000 in seed funding in 2014 and aims to help businesses grow customers, increase conversion rates, and improve retention. Their website is https://beeketing.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/rwh2xXW5FGqE2P.

Beelinguapp is an EdTech software that uses a Karaoke Audiobook format to teach languages. It shows text in two languages side by side and plays audio while displaying a karaoke animation. The company received $1.1 million in pre-seed funding in 2016 and its website is http://www.beelinguapp.com/.
Bellwethr is a tech startup that raised $2.5M in seed funding in 2019. The company's website offers no information about its product or service, but a pitch deck is available at the provided URL.

BenRevo is a platform that simplifies the process of buying health insurance for employers by connecting all parties through a digital marketplace, improving transparency and automating the mid-market insurance space. The company raised $2.4 million in seed funding in 2015 and aims to streamline the $185 billion insurance industry.

Bento is a San Francisco-based food delivery service that offers Asian-inspired cuisine. Customers use the app to choose a main dish and four side dishes from a rotating menu. The patent-pending packaging allows for delivery in an average of 15 minutes, and customers can track their server's location and progress. Since launching in 2015, Bento has seen double-digit week-over-week growth.

Bespoken Spirits is a food and beverage company that uses proprietary ACTivation technology to tailor spirits for aroma, color, and taste in just days. The company raised $2.6 million in seed funding in 2018 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

http://bidaway.com/ is an online auction platform for travel and activity packages, offering exclusive partnerships with hotels and entertainment providers. The platform creates an efficient marketplace for unsold items and optimizes utilization rates for partners. In 2012, the company raised $2.9 million in later-stage funding.

BIGcontrols is a blockchain platform that automates regulatory compliance for tax incentives between corporations and government agencies, providing real-time intelligence for corporate tax and finance leaders and ROI for government jurisdictions. The company received $125,000 in seed funding in 2014 and has a website and pitch deck available.

BillTrim is a service that uses proprietary technology and a professional team to negotiate lower bills for customers, charging a small percentage of the savings. They received $150,000 in seed funding in 2016 and operate in the Other industry.

Healthcare startup Bind raised $70M in a Series-A funding round in 2019. The company's website is https://www.yourbind.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/w76tBsNXCSx7qk.

Binpress is a company that helps developers build profitable businesses from open-source projects by providing customization, integration, and support services. It offers permissive commercial licensing and guaranteed support to reduce risk and friction for businesses adopting open-source. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, Binpress received $1 million in seed funding and operates in the "Other" industry.

Biogrify, founded in 2011, is a platform that allows users to visually tell their life stories, from daily details to major milestones. The company's website is http://www.biogrify.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/ynVIGNC9FwuxAo.

Biomarker Labs is a San Francisco-based health and wellness technology startup that offers a mobile app allowing consumers to test and assess the effects of any diet, supplement, or workout on their own bodies using their own health data. The app also serves as an unbiased data platform for health and nutrition brands to quantify their product claims by letting end consumers test their products and see the results. As of 2016, Biomarker Labs was in the seed stage.

Birdie is a platform that provides tailored preventive care for older adults to age confidently in their own homes. The platform helps care providers plan, monitor, and assess patients digitally, reducing admin costs and enabling real-time visibility. In 2017, Birdie raised $12.6M in a Series-B funding round and was founded by Abeed Mohamed, Max Parmentier, Rajiv Tanna, and Gwen Le Calvez.

Bitspawn is a blockchain-based gaming platform that rewards players for providing liquidity in competitive marketplaces, creating new revenue streams for gamers. The company raised $6.8 million in a seed round in 2021 and aims to help gamers monetize their gameplay.

BlaBlaCar is a long-distance carpooling community connecting drivers and passengers traveling the same way, sharing the costs of the journey. The platform creates a secure, trust-based community with declared identities and full member profiles. It operates in 22 countries and is backed by several venture capital firms. BlaBlaCar is based in Paris with offices across a dozen countries.

Bliinx is a tool for GTM teams to find their product's most qualified users for faster conversions or expansion revenue. The company raised $863,400 in a pre-seed round in 2019 and offers a solution based on user behavior and social engagement without requiring engineering, operations, or IT assistance. Their website is https://www.bliinx.com/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/tVUGGuYMNnLF6i.

http://bliss.ai/ provides insights on technical debt and code quality, using person-centric code analysis to encourage developers to continuously improve. Founded in 2015, http://bliss.ai/ is in the seed stage and operates in the Other industry. Visit their website at http://bliss.ai/ or view their pitch deck at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/9QfHpMdLqfcVyZ.

Blue Studios is a company that builds tools and software to onboard families into Web3. They received $1.3 million in funding in 2019 at the pre-seed stage and have a website and pitch deck available online.

Blue Wire is a San Francisco-based audio-centric media company that hosts podcasts with athletes, influencers, and professional sports franchises. It acquires and launches podcasts about one team or one specific topic. The company raised $12.5 million in 2018 and operates in the Other industry. Its pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/42gaGnX6pRaceY.

Blueboard is an experiential rewards and recognition platform that allows companies to reward employees with curated experiences and activities. Founded in 2013 and based in San Francisco, it raised $15.8 million in a Series-A funding round in 2014.

Blurbiz Media is a SaaS-based platform that allows users to create, edit, and distribute mobile-optimized videos. Founded in 2015 and based in Houston, Texas, Blurbiz Media received $125,000 in seed funding and offers tools for scheduling video publishing across multiple social media networks.

Bohemian Guitars is an e-commerce guitar brand known for innovative, stylish, and affordable products, philanthropy, and great customer service. The company raised $279,200 in seed funding in 2012 and has a website and pitch deck available online.

Bonyu is a company that provides the world's first breast milk analysis service, BONYU CHECK, and has a capital alliance with Pigeon, a leading company in the lactation-related market. The company aims to elucidate the mechanism, nutritional reference value, and correlation between breast milk and maternal and child health, and establish services to improve social issues and worries. In 2018, the company raised $150 million and is categorized under the "Other" industry. Their website is https://bonyu.me/ and their pitch deck can be found at https://www.slideshare.net/slideshow/embed_code/key/IJw8feBBrveT0R.

Boon is a talent crowdsourcing marketplace that uses social and psychological engagement components with data science to help companies hire the best talent in their organization's networks and boosts referred talent by 63%. They received $1.5 million in seed funding in 2016 and offer custom rewards and gamification to inspire action, as well as deep integrations and stats dashboards to provide clarity and integrity to a referral program.

Boon + Gable is a virtual personal shopper that provides monthly recommendations through the mail. The platform offers a personal stylist who comes to the client's home with a curated selection of clothes for them to try, then buy on the spot if they happen to like them. The service uses a recommendation engine called Clark to filter down the universe of clothing available in local stores to a few hundred pieces that fit the client's style, size, budget, and needs. The company raised $2.5 million in seed funding in 2019.

http://boostup.ai/ is a Front Office Revenue Operations and Intelligence platform that helps sales teams achieve forecasting accuracy, efficiency, predictability, and growth across the entire sales process. The platform creates complete transparency, automates processes, and identifies risk and opportunity in the pipeline while improving forecasting rigor and accuracy. http://boostup.ai/ has raised $56.8 million in a Series B funding round and is used by leading companies such as Teradata, Degreed, ContentSquare, Workato, and Iterable to drive predictable revenue growth.

Botsociety is a platform that allows designers and marketers to preview and prototype conversational interfaces. The company has grown 30% month over month in the last 6 months and has over 200 paying customers, including Accenture, Nike, and Microsoft. In 2017, Botsociety raised $150,000 in seed funding.

Bottlepay, a payments platform built on top of the bitcoin network, raised $17.5 million in a 2019 seed round. The company provides mobile payment, mobile banking, and financial services and is headquartered in Tyne, England.

BottlesTonight is a same-day bottle service booking app for nightclubs and lounges that guarantees the best prices on bottle service. It reduces the minimum spend required to book bottle service and discounts bottles up to 70% off normal menu prices, listing unsold inventory on its mobile app marketplace for consumers to book from their smartphones. Founded in 2013, it facilitates bookings for 90% of nightclubs in San Francisco and Los Angeles, and is launching soon in Las Vegas and New York. It received $260,000 in seed funding in 2013.

BoxC is an e-commerce logistics platform that simplifies global shipping and logistics services with a single API. The platform handles customs, duties, taxes, and dangerous items pre-screening, allowing online retailers to focus on growing their business. BoxC received $725,000 in funding in 2013 and is in the later stage of development.

BRD is a financial software company that offers a platform for crypto purchasing, credit rating information, and merchant services. Founded in 2015, it has headquarters in Zurich and has raised $54.8 million in funding.

Brewpublik is an e-commerce retailer for craft beer that uses proprietary technology to match customers' taste profiles to new products. They generate revenue from selling products and insights. They received $125,000 in funding in 2014 and position themselves as the central nervous system of the industry.

Brex is a San Francisco-based fintech company that offers business credit cards and cash management accounts to technology companies. The company has raised $182 million in funding, with a pre-money valuation of $975 million, and is currently in Series B stage.

Bridge is an immigration provider that combines software and legal experts to help companies execute efficient immigration processes, provide a better experience for international employees, and run a more proactive and informed immigration function. They received $800,000 in seed funding in 2011.

http://bright.md/ is an AI-powered virtual-care platform that partners with healthcare organizations to offer SmartExam to over 10 million patients seeking convenient online care, reducing visits and connecting them to their physicians via a home computer or mobile device. The company raised $29.2 million in a Series C funding round in 2014 and is based in Portland, Oregon.
